subdimensions.name: Suffering Detection
subdimensions.note: Axon launched a national database tracking gun-related deaths between police and the public, a proactive mechanism aimed at the harm it says it exists to reduce.

evidence.quote: Axon Launches National Database to Track Gun-Related Deaths Between Police and Public

subdimensions.name: Contextual Sensitivity
subdimensions.note: Axon issues population-specific warnings for people who are agitated, intoxicated or have impaired heart function, groups Reuters found over-represented among Taser deaths.

evidence.quote: Reuters documented more than 1,000 cases through the end of 2018 in which people died after being shocked by police with a Taser

subdimensions.name: Blind Spot Mitigation
subdimensions.note: Nine of twelve AI Ethics Board members resigned in June 2022, stating the company disregarded their advice. The blind-spot mechanism existed and was overridden.

evidence.quote: Statement of Resigning Axon AI Ethics Board Members

subdimensions.name: Signal Amplification
subdimensions.note: Reuters documented Axon working to place vendor-paid experts first into investigations of Taser-related deaths, which is the opposite of amplifying the affected party.

evidence.quote: a sweeping operation by Axon Enterprise Inc., the new name of Taser's manufacturer, to make sure that vendor-paid experts were often the first to provide analysis and expertise when Taser-related deaths were investigated

subdimensions.name: Anticipatory Awareness
subdimensions.note: The Electronic Frontier Foundation found Draft One shipped without audit capability by design, and Axon proceeded with Taser drones after its ethics board advised against.

evidence.quote: Axon's Draft One Is Designed to Defy Transparency

subdimensions.name: Affective Resonance
subdimensions.note: No evidence located on how affected members of the public experience Axon's products. Absence of disclosure.

evidence.quote: PROTECT RESPONSIBILITY PROTECT LIFE 2025 Responsibility Report

subdimensions.name: Perspective-Taking
subdimensions.note: Asked how agencies could audit AI-written reports, Axon replied that this 'wasn't a scenario we anticipated needing to make easy'.

evidence.quote: To set expectations, it's not going to be graceful, but this wasn't a scenario we anticipated needing to make easy.

subdimensions.name: Non-Judgment
subdimensions.note: Reuters found at least 32 percent of people who died after Taser shocks were Black, a disproportionate share. No Axon investigation of that disparity was located.

evidence.quote: police killed 1000 people tasers since 2000

subdimensions.name: Validation
subdimensions.note: Documented pattern of contesting rather than validating accounts of Taser-related deaths. Scored at the absence anchor because the Reuters window closes in 2018.

evidence.quote: a sweeping operation by Axon Enterprise Inc., the new name of Taser's manufacturer, to make sure that vendor-paid experts were often the first to provide analysis and expertise when Taser-related deaths were investigated

subdimensions.name: Transparency
